overview.description: The Franklin XRP ETF (XRPZ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in long xrp, short usd currency. The fund tracks an index to provide the price performance of XRP. The Trust offers an alternative to trading and holding XRP directly. XRPZ was launched on Nov 24, 2025 and is issued by Franklin Templeton.
